title: OrganizerTrialStatus
description: An organizer's free trial, computed on the server from the effective commercial terms and organizerGrowthFacts. The trial starts at the first event (the start of the first non-cancelled event with a booking), or the first paid booking when no event is recorded. notStarted: neither has happened. scheduled: the first event is booked but has not started. none: the terms give no trial. unconfigured: Catch's platform terms are not saved. Nothing gates features when the trial ends; the next billing cycle is billed.

daysLeft.description: Whole days left, rounded up, while scheduled or active.
